opening.argument: The presentation promotes a front-running bot with immediate and approximately 15x return claims while directing viewers through downloading and funding a wallet, connecting it to Binance Smart Chain, and deploying and funding a contract. The claimed mechanism is explicit: it will “transact the liquidity as soon as it's added to a token” and sell after a one-minute interval, while “90 percent will automatically trans back to your wallet” and 10 percent remains in the protocol. The speaker further describes front-running retail investors and reports having made “several hundred bnb,” alongside the statement that the result is “already around 15x.” These claims are paired with a download link, password, and listed auto-sell features. The frames are consistent with a deployment and wallet-confirmation walkthrough, but they do not independently verify the contract’s behavior, profitability, or the download’s destination and contents.
